# Billy Andrews

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c15 P40](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0040), [v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c11 P18](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0018), [v1 c15 P2](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0002)</sub>

## Appearance

Billy is a big, fat, stolid youth with a round, expressionless face. He has a broad, freckled countenance and a painful lack of conversational gifts.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)_

## Personality

Billy is a quiet and bashful young man who rarely talks, often resorting to grinning and chuckling when spoken to. Despite his stolid and silent demeanor, he is very admired by those who know him and takes great pride in driving or accompanying others. He is also noted for being extremely shy, which makes him reluctant to speak at length.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)_

## Traits

- Quiet  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- Bashful  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- Stolid  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>

## Abilities

- Driving a horse and buggy  <sub>[v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>

## History

Billy Andrews is a young man living in Avonlea with his family. He drove his sister Jane, Anne Shirley, and Diana Barry to a concert at the White Sands Hotel in his family's double-seated buggy. During the drive, he insisted that Anne sit on the front seat with him, though his extreme shyness prevented him from engaging in much conversation beyond grinning and chuckling. While the ladies attended the concert supper, Billy waited outside with his team of horses out of fear of being invited in. Afterwards, he drove the girls safely back home under the moonlight.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v1 c33 P39](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0039)_
